title: 30-Point Heat Map Schema
description: Complete JSON schema for the multifamily investment criteria heat map

id.description: Unique identifier (msa_1 through msa_16, sub_1 through sub_14)

threshold.description: The passing criteria threshold from the Immutable Laws

value.description: The actual value found during research

status.description: Traffic light status: GREEN = Pass, YELLOW = Caution, RED = Fail

reasoning.description: Detailed explanation of why this status was assigned

source.description: Citation: Document name + Page/Section or URL

override_applied.description: True if user-uploaded context document overrode market data

override_document.description: Name of the context document that provided override data
